text: Al Jazeera reports DR Congo Ebola deaths have passed 5,000. Government data as of Oct 28: 10,274 confirmed cases, 4,992 deaths. Pulse Nigeria reports spread to Nigeria; there is no official statement yet.

judge.comment: Figures are consistent with the digest, but sources conflict (the tracker KPI still shows 4,478 deaths from CDC) and the Nigeria spread is a single-outlet, unconfirmed report. A human should check the framing.

factChecks.claim: DRC deaths above 5,000 per Al Jazeera
Government data as of Oct 28: 10,274 confirmed cases and 4,992 deaths
Pulse Nigeria reports spread to Nigeria, not officially confirmed

text: Israel's military has withdrawn from the West Bank city of Hebron after a 10-day operation, per Washington Post. Al Jazeera reported on Oct 30 that the siege had displaced thousands of residents.

judge.comment: Both claims are attributed to named outlets and match the tracker events. No casualty or displacement figure is invented.

factChecks.claim: Israeli military withdrew from Hebron after a 10-day operation (Washington Post)
Al Jazeera Oct 30: siege displaced thousands

text: Yemeni government troops killed in the Aug 6 Marib/Hadramout offensive: the government confirmed at least 30. A military source told AFP the toll may have reached 58. The Houthis claim 45. One operation, three tallies.

judge.comment: Presents all three attributed figures without adjudicating, with the as-of date of Aug 6. Contested posts are never auto-approved.

factChecks.claim: Government confirmed at least 30 soldiers killed (Aug 6)
Military source told AFP toll may have reached 58

text: North Korea rejected US allegations over the Binance crypto heist, calling them a 'grave political provocation' and 'absurd rhetoric' (KCNA). The FBI had attributed the $6.3bn hack to the DPRK on Nov 1. Neither side has published evidence in public.

judge.comment: Quotes and attribution match the tracker. The closing sentence about evidence is not in the tracker data and is unverifiable; remove it before publishing.

factChecks.claim: KCNA called allegations a 'grave political provocation' and 'absurd rhetoric'
FBI attributed $6.3bn Binance hack to North Korea on Nov 1
Neither side has published evidence in public

text: Lebanon's health ministry counts 4,386 dead since 2 Mar, with no civilian/combatant split. On Hezbollah fighters, Hezbollah sources say 1,000+; the IDF and independent estimates say 1,700–2,500. Hezbollah publishes no totals. (Tracker data, as of Nov 3)

judge.comment: Both sides are attributed and nothing is adjudicated. Fighter-count figures carry no individual as-of date, so a human should confirm the framing.

factChecks.claim: Lebanon total 4,386 (Ministry of Public Health), cumulative since 2 Mar, no split
